parsed.claim: The trivial group (Unit) is Sofic in the Lean sense: for every finite set F and ε in (0,1) there is a concrete PermutationModel (size 1, trivial action) satisfying GoodOn. This shows the Sofic, PermutationModel and GoodOn definitions are satisfiable.
parsed.lean:
theorem probe_sofic_unit : SoficGroups.Sofic Unit := by
  refine ⟨fun F ε hε _ => ⟨⟨1, Nat.one_pos, fun _ => 1, rfl⟩, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · intro g _ h _
    simp [SoficGroups.normalizedHamming, hε]
  · intro g _ hg
    exact absurd (Subsingleton.elim g 1) hg
